## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (96%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Invasive risk is 0% with full model agreement [F1], routed to tier 1 as a surgical frozen section.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 96%, Benign 3%, InSitu 1%, Invasive 0% | Strong Normal call, minimal risk |
| Conformal set | {Normal} (alpha 10%; 90% test coverage, CI 76%–98%) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100% OOD (12 regions; JPEG 3) [F6] | Reliable, atypical OOD; AUROC 70% |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (75%–77%); InSitu contrast 70% [F5] | Neighbors match; InSitu contrast nearby |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 1, 4, 6) · context · Above typical (1.93, contribution -1.61); 8/20 AI spot check [F2] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 2, 3, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above typical (1.20, contribution -0.52); 20/20 AI spot check [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 6, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Text-only score (1.14, contribution -0.30), caption-inconsistent; 18/20 spot check [F4] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.16, contribution -0.29); 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.13, contribution +0.29); 12/20 AI spot check · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability over random (+0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), and necrosis (3/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Focal lesion in region 2 (65% risk) or InSitu mimic like contrast case BACH_0347 (70% similarity) is missed.
- Simulated JPEG compression (severity 3) or disabled cell segmentation obscures atypia near medial (78%) or inferior (74%) margins [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 3**: Inspect for focal atypia or invasion driving the 65% and 13% regional risk scores.
2. **Regions 1, 4, 6**: Verify dense lymphocytic infiltrate and exclude masked in situ or invasive epithelium.
3. **Regions 8, 3**: Check medial (78%), inferior (74%), and lateral (69%) surgical margin edges despite clear call.
